primary_question: On 12 unseen tasks, does Agent v4 Python ON execute the canonical USERF/EFACT/FORMULA path and improve external quantitative goal attainment versus identical Python OFF?
primary_population: required; pipeline isolation primary, end-to-end secondary
numeric_authority: Frozen independent GT and deterministic scorer; semantic reviewer cannot change numeric values.
numeric_match: Target value within frozen absolute tolerance and target unit or exact equivalent in local answer context. A bare value without identifiable target context does not match.
unit_match: Explicit target unit or frozen equivalent near the result; fraction and percentage may be converted if explicitly labelled.
criterion_pass: All numeric targets mapped to a criterion pass; qualitative claims and citations pass a single blinded semantic review.
goal_success: All fixed criteria pass, no material engineering contradiction or hallucination.
external_coverage: Fraction of fixed criteria passing external adjudication; never use internal goal_coverage as the score.
task_funnel: Aggregate all iterations as ever_* and furthest reached stage; preserve per-iteration trace.
conditional_execution_success: validated CALC / plans with facts and formula verified
calc_adoption: A validated CALC numeric result appears accurately in the final answer with a CALC citation where applicable.
benefit: ON external coverage exceeds OFF or ON matches more frozen numeric targets.
neutral: Neither condition exceeds the other in external coverage or numeric targets.
harm: ON external coverage is lower or ON matches fewer frozen numeric targets.
strong_benefit: OFF fails a numeric criterion, ON has a validated CALC, and ON passes that numeric criterion.

semantic_reviewer.scope: qualitative engineering meaning, citation support, hallucination only

manual_qa: Review all 24 final answers; preserve raw reviewer and deterministic scores; any correction is a separate strict_adjudicated_v1_1 artifact.
